scope: Roll out the approved v2 controls (Soft square buttons, Filled box fields, Figtree type) to every page of the Vidra file, move all text and paints onto v2 styles and tokens, then delete the old Vidra Fresh controls, text styles and color tokens and make the v2 names canonical.
approach: Missing v2 pieces were built before any swap so every old control had a v2 target: a Raised mode, Password field, Select, five text styles and eight role tokens.

Each page was swapped with swapComponent in one atomic call. Text, boolean and instance-swap properties, size and prototype reactions were re-applied, 36px controls moved to the 32px v2 height, and Field and Password values captured beforehand were restored where nested swaps dropped them.

Paints were rebound by role to v2 Interface tokens, keeping appearance except for intended control-state changes; text moved to the matching v2 style; phrase underlines took one style per phrase kind.

A sweep and a pre-delete audit ran on all 20 pages before the old components, styles and tokens were deleted. The final check after deletion switched to every page and walked every node, including instance contents.

New tokens: surface/rail, surface/selection, overlay/mask, toolbar/group, toolbar/primary, phrase/selected, phrase/surface and badge/video (Brand amber/400 #dfae48).

postDeleteRepair.Found: The post-deletion check found 195 references to deleted color tokens on 01 · Design system. No other page had any.
postDeleteRepair.Hidden base fills: 20 'Applied prompt words' text layers in the Composer content / Prompt components kept Vidra Model white on the base fill of mixed-fill text. Every character carries its own phrase fill, so the base fill is invisible, and the pre-delete audit read only per-character fills. Each base fill was rebound to text/primary and every character fill re-applied; the fills were verified identical before and after.
postDeleteRepair.Late bindings: 82 layers in Composer controls, Timing controls, Caption style, Segment, Field bar, Video settings, Model settings, Library controls, Share panel, Output settings, Setting chip, Select, Menu and Toolbar / Mobile editor were bound to the old color/panel, border, muted, white and raised. The Component visual design critique session made these bindings while restyling every dropdown as a recessed field bar. The user asked for that at 18:34 CDT (23:34 UTC), after the clean pre-delete audit (23:32 UTC) and before the deletion (23:40 UTC). 91 paints were rebound to Interface tokens with identical values: panel to surface/panel #1a1a1a (40), border to border/default #363636 (44), muted to text/muted #949494 (4), white to text/primary #f7f7f7 (2), raised to surface/raised #242424 (1). The components rendered unchanged, and the critique session was told which tokens to use.

verification: Final check, switched into each page so every node including instance contents was walked: 0 broken instances, 0 text layers with a missing style and 0 bindings to deleted variables on all 20 pages.

A faster check that loaded pages without switching to them reached only part of each page (for example 90 of 2,568 nodes on 03), so its results were discarded and every page was re-checked with a page switch.

Rendered and inspected: the components rebound after deletion (Timing controls, Composer controls, Caption style, Segment, Field bar, Model settings, Output settings) and representative screens on every page with content: 00, 01, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 and 02 · States · Editor & export.
